subject: words
title: Ow and oe: snow, toe
about: The other face of ow: here it says long o (snow, grow), and oe says long o at the end of a word (toe, goes). CKLA Grade 1 teaches only oa for this sound (Unit 7) and leaves ow and oe to Grade 2, so open this after the Oa level; it is where he learns that ow can be cow or snow and he has to try both. NC RF.1.4.c (vowel teams for long vowel sounds).
tip: If an ow word sounds wrong, say: try it the other way, like in snow.
